name: Cast conditions — main phase, mana spent and evidence branches read the spell's toggle
notes: Sweep theme 7 (2026-10-06). "If you cast this spell during your main phase / if {B} was spent / if at least three green mana was spent / if evidence was collected, …" either produced nothing or applied unconditionally (Outmuscle gave every permanent indestructible; Arrester's Zeal always gave flying). They now use the same one-toggle branch as kicker. Might of Old Krosa with the toggle off is +2/+2 only (Bears 4/4). Arrester's Zeal with it on gives +2/+2 and flying to its one target (Ogre 4/4). Outmuscle with it off gives nothing to anyone. Behind the Mask with evidence collected still makes its target an artifact creature, but 1/1 instead of 4/3.
